review_notes: I read the whole file and searched the library for repeated blocks. The four theorems prove different things: injective flatness by composing flat maps, non-injective flatness by regular-difference annihilation, prime-spectrum surjectivity by evaluation and a retraction, and faithful flatness by combining the earlier results. The only shared pieces are the collision extraction from ¬Injective, which is a short routine step, and a few short ring-hom computations. Neither is substantial enough to justify a shared lemma under this rubric. I did not find nontrivial reasoning repeated in two proofs of this file.
